verdict.rationale: LiveKit's first-party Egress docs state that a session can be recorded to HLS segments and exported to live streaming services such as YouTube Live, Twitch and Facebook via RTMP, so a large audience can watch without joining the room. The docs also mention automatic recording when a room is created. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of RTMP/HLS egress at audience scale, and deeper documentation of live HLS playback delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session

citations.quote: It supports recording to an MP4 file or HLS segments, as well as exporting to live streaming services like YouTube Live, Twitch, and Facebook via RTMP.
